item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi dbang khrid 'gu ya gting rdzogs
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni blo dman rnams kyi don ched du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhas grub chen po smra ba'i seng ge bsod nams ye shes mtshan can gyi zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i/ gdan sa ba bsod nams g.yung drung gis blo dman rnams la bde ba'i phyir du bsgrigs pa'o//
